title: Governance Metrics Framework
description: Defines the governance metrics framework: what to measure, how to measure it, targets, and reporting cadence. All metrics are designed to be computable from existing data (governance_event_registry.json, REVISION_HISTORY.md, governance_guard_engine.js output).

metricCategories.description: Measures the volume and severity of governance violations

metrics.name: Total Violations (Current)
metrics.definition: Count of OPEN VIOLATION events in governance_event_registry.json

metrics.name: New Violations (Last 30 Days)
metrics.definition: Count of VIOLATION events created in the last 30 days

metrics.name: Repeat Violations Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of VIOLATION events where the same QID+Rule combination appears more than once

metricCategories.description: Measures how quickly governance violations are detected

metrics.name: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD)
metrics.definition: Average time between violation introduction and detection by governance guard engine or policy drift detector
metrics.source: Delta between event.created and the session that introduced the violation (from REVISION_HISTORY.md)

metrics.name: Detection Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of defect classes (DL-IDs) covered by automated detection
metrics.source: Cross-reference DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-IDs against governance_guard_engine.js and policy_drift_detector.js rules

metricCategories.description: Measures how quickly violations are resolved

metrics.name: Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
metrics.definition: Average time between VIOLATION event creation and CLOSED status
metrics.source: governance_event_registry.js — compute created-to-closed delta for CLOSED events

metrics.name: Aged Violations (>30 Days)
metrics.definition: Count of VIOLATION events still OPEN after 30 days

metrics.name: Resolution Rate (30-Day)
metrics.definition: Percentage of VIOLATION events created in last 30 days that have been CLOSED
metrics.source: governance_event_registry.js — compute closed/created ratio over 30d window

metrics.name: Exception-to-Violation Ratio
metrics.definition: Ratio of EXCEPTION events to total VIOLATION events over 30 days

metricCategories.description: Measures certification audit coverage and quality

metrics.name: Audit Chain Coverage
metrics.definition: Percentage of questions that have at least one certification audit chain entry
metrics.source: certification_audit_builder.js — chains with session count > 0 / total QIDs

metrics.name: Certification Reversion Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of Certified items that were decertified (Certified → In Audit) in the last 30 days
metrics.source: REVISION_HISTORY.md — count Certified→In Audit transitions / total Certified
